# heraut commit create

Interactively author a Conventional Commits message and commit it.

Write a Conventional Commits message step by step (type, scope, description, body, breaking change,
tickets) and run git commit with it. Needs an interactive terminal.

## Usage

```text
heraut commit create [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut commit create
heraut commit create --all
heraut commit create --dry-run
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-a`, `--all` |  | stage all tracked modifications before committing (git commit -a) |
| `--dry-run` |  | print actions without executing them |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
